messages:
Alex M.: Morning all — brief async for today. What I did: deployed model v1.2 to staging and ran a couple of latency profiles (seq len 256). Blockers: seeing a small tail latency bump on p99 for long prompts when KV cache hits are low. Today: digging into batching heuristics and will open an RFC if I need to change default batch_timeout. /cc @Sam for CRs and @Erin for perf dashboard tweaks. :coffee:

Erin: Nice work — saw the staging run. Quick note: dashboard shows p50/p90 steady, p99 +12% around 01:15 UTC, likely correlated with a burst of long-seq requests. I'll add an annotation and share link in a sec. :eyes:

Sam: Re: CR queue — pinged on #PR-452 (runtime: batching backpressure). Left one minor comment about backoff jitter. If Alex wants, I can prioritize review after lunch. @Alex M. :thumbsup:

Priya: FYI, customer X reported a small increase in latency for their dedicated cluster yesterday. I raised a support ticket and attached request traces. Might be related if they had long prefix contexts. Ticket ID: SUP-9988.

Luis: On my side, finished the test harness for KV cache TTL experiments. I pushed to test-env branch `kv-ttl-experiments` and added a simple harness:```bash
./run_kv_bench --model r2-small --seq 512 --warmup 1000 --iter 5000
``` Will share results by EOD.

Nora (deploy-bot): Reminder: canary rollout for model v1.2 scheduled in 45m. Current canary hosts: 3/10 healthy, autoscaler will step if target not hit in 15m. Logs -> https://console.redwood.dev/deploys/2134012345

Alex M.: Thanks — Erin, can you drop that annotation link? Sam, prioritizing PR-452 after lunch would be great. Luis, thanks for the harness — plumb the output into the perf dashboard if you can. Priya, I'll sync with support and include traces in the incident thread if it looks correlated.

Erin: Annotation posted: https://console.redwood.dev/observability/annos/ann-2134 — shows the spike window. Also added a quick query to compare seq len distribution: `seq_len > 256` percent over time.

Sam: Reviewed CR-452 comments, replying now. If we land the backoff change it should reduce the tail under bursty load. Quick test plan: A/B rollout to 10% traffic on staging then promote.

Priya: Updated the support ticket with the deploy link and Erin's annotation. SUP-9988 now has traces + annotation. I'll keep customer updated.

Alex M.: Plan for next steps: 1) Sam lands PR-452 and we A/B test on staging; 2) Luis runs TTL harness and posts numbers; 3) Erin monitors p99 during canary; 4) Priya correlates customer traces. If anyone hits blockers, drop here or DM. Thanks! :rocket:
